name: Beverly Center
description: Beverly Center is Southern California's quintessential shopping center featuring over 100 stores and restaurants. Located at the intersection of Beverly Boulevard and La Cienega in the heart of Los Angeles, this iconic eight-story enclosed mall offers a premier shopping experience with a diverse mix of luxury and contemporary retailers. The center serves as a major retail destination for West Hollywood and the greater Los Angeles area with convenient access to the city's most fashionable neighborhoods.
demographics: Beverly Center attracts an affluent and diverse demographic, with primary visitors ranging from ages 25-54 with above-average household incomes exceeding $75,000 annually. The trade area encompasses West Hollywood, Beverly Hills, and surrounding Los Angeles neighborhoods, drawing fashion-forward shoppers, tourists, and entertainment industry professionals. Visitors typically seek contemporary and designer brands with strong preferences for fashion, beauty, and upscale dining experiences, making it a destination for trend-conscious consumers willing to spend on quality retail experiences.
summary: Beverly Center is a landmark eight-story regional mall in the heart of Los Angeles featuring over 100 stores and restaurants serving West Hollywood and surrounding upscale neighborhoods.
